parents.criterion: Reads as freshly minted rather than a circulated chestnut
parents.instruction: Score how much the item reads as a joke the writer constructed versus a standard that has been in circulation for decades and is reproduced here verbatim. 10 = the premise, the pivot and the phrasing all feel newly assembled; a well-read judge does not recognise it. 5 = a familiar frame with a new payload, or a new frame with a familiar payload. 0 = a canonical chestnut whose punchline the judge could recite before reaching it, transcribed with no alteration. Judge only recognisability and staleness of the material as text; do not consider how the item might be received.

Score 10 when the text is grammatically clear, self-contained, and presents the setup and punch in an easy-to-follow form; score 0 when missing context, broken formatting, typos, or truncation obstruct comprehension.

parents.criterion: Cleanliness of commitment to one delivery format
parents.instruction: Score 0-10 for the EXTENT to which the item commits, without deviation, to a single recognisable joke format: pure one-liner, question-and-answer riddle, scripted dialogue with speaker labels, narrative build, or list. 0 = no identifiable format, the text drifts or stops without a formal shape; 5 = a recognisable format that is broken somewhere, mixing narration into a riddle or adding stray commentary after the punch; 10 = one format executed strictly from first word to last, with the punch positioned exactly where that format places it and nothing appended. Score only structural conformity to a template. Do NOT judge whether the format was the right choice, whether the punch is good, or whether the item is funny; a flat joke in a perfectly clean question-and-answer shape scores 10.
parents.upstream_parent: poster's accumulated practice in writing for this format (how many times they have done this before)

parents.instruction: Score 0-10 for how much the text contains dated public figures, events, platform conventions, current-affairs references, or period-specific slang and idiom; do not judge topicality or whether the feature or joke is good.
parents.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream and submission timing
